podcast.title: COVID-19 Related Death
podcast.body: David Greenfield, the keyboardist for The Stranglers, passed away as a result of complications from COVID-19. He is one of several musicians who did not survive the pandemic. "David Greenfield, the key boarder for the stranglers, Grammy winner John Prime, Alan Merrill, who wrote the song, I Love Rock and Roll."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
